contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG ; R/ VICTORA AVG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Postumus (260-269), Cologne mint issue of 260-265, Sear volume 3 page 304 no. 10996, RIC volume 5 part 2, nos 89-90 (which gives mint as Lyon); Cunetio no. 2369:2, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath aloft; captive at fet. Reverse…
